questions.question: Choose the sentence with no spelling error.

• Option 3 uses "**shuok"** which is not a word in English.

questions.question:

Analogous
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 1'**. i.e. **'Dissimilar'.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• **Analogous **refers to being similar in some way, comparable to something else. (किसी तरह समान, किसी और चीज़ के समकक्ष।)

 
 
• **Synonyms**: Comparable, parallel, similar, akin.
 
• **Example **Sentence: The structure of a bird's wing is analogous to that of a bat's wing.
 
 
 
• **Dissimilar **refers to the quality of being different or not alike. (अलग होने की गुणवत्ता या एक दूसरे की तरह नहीं होना।)
 
 
• **Synonyms**: Unalike, different, distinct, disparate.
 
• **Example Sentence**: Though they are twins, their tastes and preferences are quite dissimilar.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is** Option 1.**

• **"Puzzle"** (पहेली) means a confusing problem.
 
• **"Straight"** (सीधा) is not related to the concept of similarity.

questions.question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose ‘No error’. 

Methanol is released from pectin, and is therefore many abundant in fermented fruit.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 1'.**

__
 
• The phrase **"and is therefore many abundant"** is incorrect in the context of the sentence.
 
• The **error is the use** of the word **"many"** before **"abundant".**
 
• The **correct phrase **should be "*and is therefore more abundant".*
 
• The word **"many"** is not required as it doesn't provide the comparative degree needed here.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *'**Methanol is released from pectin, and is therefore** more** abundant in fermented fruit.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "Methanol is released from pectin," and "abundant in fermented fruit." are both correct segments of the sentence.
 
• **"Many" **(बहुत सारे) is used to describe a large number of something countable, but it's not used with adjectives like "abundant".
